sql: SELECT y.trip_date, y.avg_trip_distance AS avg_dist, y.avg_total_amount AS avg_amount, w.snow_mm, d.d_day_name FROM whybot.yellow_daily y JOIN TPCDS_DB.date_dim d ON d.d_date = y.trip_date LEFT JOIN whybot.nyc_weather_daily w ON w.obs_date = y.trip_date WHERE y.trip_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-12-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31' AND d_dow = 7 ORDER BY y.trip_date LIMIT 500
